visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with longish dark hair wearing a tan knit beanie, a black hooded parka, and a purple/grey Karrimor backpack stands with his back to the camera outside the glass entrance of Showtime Cinemas. He raises a fist as yellow variety text appears. (2) The man is shown from the chest up, looking upward with wide eyes in a close-up shot near a glass door decorated with a Christmas wreath. (3) He points his fingers in a 'ScreenX' gesture in front of posters for 'Overlord' and 'IVE THE 1ST WORLD TOUR'. The indoor lobby is bright with overhead lighting. (4) The man walks through a dark hallway with a large illuminated 'SCREENX' sign on the wall. He wears a patterned flannel shirt under his open coat. (5) He walks down the steps of a movie theater. The screen is massive, wrapping around to the side walls (270 degrees), currently showing a red car driving through a rocky environment. The theater has green seats. (6) A montage of movie clips plays on the triple-screen setup, including 'Top Gun: Maverick' and futuristic sci-fi scenes with robots. The man stands in the center of the theater, arms outstretched. (7) He is seen at an interactive touch-screen kiosk, browsing movie options. (8) He enters a small, dark booth labeled 'ScreenX Box', waving to the camera before disappearing inside. The hallway outside the box is a bright shopping mall environment. (9) He stands in front of a green plant wall with the 'SHOWTIME CINEMAS' logo, looking directly at the camera.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian male with dark, shoulder-length hair. He wears a tan beanie, a multi-colored patterned flannel shirt, a black hooded parka, and a Karrimor backpack.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video transitions between the exterior of a modern glass building (Showtime Cinemas), the indoor cinema lobby with movie posters, a dark theater interior with tiered green seating and a 270-degree wraparound screen, and a bright mall corridor with kiosks and experience boxes.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy electronic BGM kicks in with a steady, driving beat. A male voice shouts 'ScreenX!' with high arousal and a rising pitch contour. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' SFX signals a visual transition. The narrator begins a fast-paced Mandarin monologue with clear articulation and an excited tone. (3) Synthetic digital 'ping' SFX emphasize the appearance of variety text on screen. The BGM maintains a consistent 128 BPM tempo. (4) During the movie clips, low-frequency 'boom' and rumble SFX are mixed into the master track to simulate the theater's audio system. (5) The narrator's pitch increases as he describes the 270-degree view. Another 'whoosh' transition occurs. (6) A playful cartoon 'ding' SFX sounds when the man waves before entering the box. The music and vocals overlap continuously throughout the track. (7) The volume of the BGM swells slightly as the narrator delivers his final recommendation, ending with a clean hard cut.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Technical Explanation -> Visual Evidence -> Experience Recommendation -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional vlog for Showtime Cinemas' 'ScreenX' technology. It aims to showcase the immersive 270-degree viewing experience, explain the technical advantages of the triple-screen setup, and encourage viewers to visit the theater and try the free experience box.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct naming of 'Showtime Cinemas' and 'ScreenX', demonstration of the product/service, and a final recommendation to try it.
